First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: multiple groups by ability. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @regroupwithus the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Regroup Saturday Coffee Ride group ride

A Saturday road ride out of a coffee shop and bike shop in Tempe. Riders split into groups by ability and the ride is billed as no-drop. It ends back at the cafe with coffee and pastries. Routes change weekly; a recent one went to South Mountain for 46 miles.
